name: mcp__warehouse__run_sql
content:
{
  "query": "with s as (select sum(qty_base) q from marts.fct_sales f join marts.dim_sku d using(sku_code) where category_code='RESP' and business_date between '2026-07-01' and '2026-08-31'),
r as (select sum(qty_base) q from marts.fct_goods_received f join marts.dim_sku d using(sku_code) where category_code='RESP' and received_on between '2026-07-01' and '2026-08-31'),
r2 as (select sum(qty_base) q from marts.fct_goods_received f join marts.dim_sku d using(sku_code) where category_code='RESP' and received_on <= '2026-08-31'),
i as (select sum(on_hand_qty_base) q, max(snapshot_date) sd from marts.fct_inventory_batch f join marts.dim_sku d using(sku_code) where category_code='RESP')
select s.q sold, r.q recv_julaug, r2.q recv_all, i.q onhand, i.sd from s,r,r2,i"
}
